subject: Looking for a good example of reporting a grouped SEM (CFA + multiple regression).

messages.author: 89be449d770b3cc2
messages.subject: Looking for a good example of reporting a grouped SEM (CFA + multiple regression).
parts:
Hello,

It's the first time I conducted a SEM and now I have to write a report on it. 
My SEM consists of an CFA on a validated scale and a multi regression analysis ordered by 3 clusters using the 'group' function.

Does anyone know of a good example/article reporting this kind of SEM?

Thanks for your help!

messages.author: ad188126f9138663
messages.subject: Re: Looking for a good example of reporting a grouped SEM (CFA + multiple regression).
parts:
Lies,
  This is less of a lavaan question than a general SEMNET question.  However, instead of looking for an example, my suggestion would be to seek out writing about reporting SEM studies.  Table 18.1 on page 453 of Rex Kline's SEM text lists 16 references on this topic.

Kline, R. B. (2016).  Principles and practice of structural equation modeling (4th ed.).  New York: Guilford.

Keith
